cards.title: Seed Library Map Room Story Arc Card
cards.arcSkill: plant one beginning detail that returns later
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only accordion folder card for shaping a Seed Library Map Room story arc from first clue to return note: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: keep the work private and offline, place this card, blank paper, pencil, and an accordion folder on the table: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: with the adult, sort the made-up seed map story into beginning, middle change, choice, result, and ending return: ____________________.
cards.beginningPrompt: Beginning: write one seed packet mark, map-room shelf, or careful map clue that starts the story arc: ____________________.
cards.middleChangePrompt: Middle change: show how the map room changes when one pretend seed marker slides to a new paper square: ____________________.
cards.choiceBridgePrompt: Choice bridge: let the map keeper choose whether to follow the shelf clue or the seed packet clue next: ____________________.
cards.consequencePrompt: Consequence: write what the choice changes in the paper map room, such as a new shelf label or crossed path: ____________________.
cards.endingReturnPrompt: Ending return: bring back the beginning seed packet mark and explain how it helps the final map note make sense: ____________________.
cards.arcFolderPrompt: Arc folder note: tuck one seed map beginning detail, middle change, and ending return reminder into separate accordion pockets: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: write only the seed packet mark, one map-room change, and the ending return note: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: keep the Seed Library Map Room arc in the paper folder and add one returning clue later: ____________________.

cards.title: Moss Message Observatory Story Arc Card
cards.arcSkill: keep the middle change connected to the opening
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only accordion folder card for building a Moss Message Observatory story arc with a connected opening and middle shift: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: keep the work private and offline, set out this card with paper, pencil, and an accordion folder labeled for the observatory: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: with the adult, begin with one moss message, change it in the middle, and return to it at the ending: ____________________.
cards.beginningPrompt: Beginning: write the first moss message beside the observatory lens and name who notices it: ____________________.
cards.middleChangePrompt: Middle change: make the moss message shift shape, direction, or meaning while staying tied to the opening clue: ____________________.
cards.choiceBridgePrompt: Choice bridge: let the observer choose one paper-only way to compare the first message with the changed one: ____________________.
cards.consequencePrompt: Consequence: write what the observer understands after comparing the two moss marks in the observatory: ____________________.
cards.endingReturnPrompt: Ending return: bring back the first moss message and show how the middle change made it clearer: ____________________.
cards.arcFolderPrompt: Arc folder note: place the opening moss clue, the changed clue, and the ending return note in order inside the accordion folder: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: write one opening moss clue and one middle change that still connects to it: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: add one more Moss Message Observatory arc note that returns to the first clue on paper: ____________________.

cards.title: Clue Label Tower Museum Story Arc Card
cards.arcSkill: bring a clue-label choice back at the end
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only accordion folder card for planning a Clue Label Tower Museum story arc around one label choice: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: keep the work private and offline, provide this card, blank paper, a pencil, and an accordion folder for arc notes: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: with the adult, write how one museum label choice starts small, changes the middle, and returns at the end: ____________________.
cards.beginningPrompt: Beginning: introduce the tower museum case, the unclear clue label, and the character who must decide what it means: ____________________.
cards.middleChangePrompt: Middle change: add one new exhibit detail that makes the clue label harder or more interesting to understand: ____________________.
cards.choiceBridgePrompt: Choice bridge: let the character choose which clue label to trust and write why that choice moves the arc forward: ____________________.
cards.consequencePrompt: Consequence: write how the chosen label changes the next museum step, such as which case opens on paper: ____________________.
cards.endingReturnPrompt: Ending return: bring the chosen clue label back and explain what it means after the character sees the final case: ____________________.
cards.arcFolderPrompt: Arc folder note: file the unclear label, the choice, and the returned label in accordion folder order: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: write only the unclear label, the chosen label, and the ending meaning: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: keep the Clue Label Tower Museum arc private in the paper folder and add one new label clue later: ____________________.

cards.title: Compass Craft Academy Story Arc Card
cards.arcSkill: use a compass note to keep the arc pointed at one pretend goal
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only accordion folder card for guiding a Compass Craft Academy story arc toward one pretend goal: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: keep the work private and offline, place this card beside paper, pencil, and an accordion folder for compass notes: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: with the adult, choose one pretend compass goal and let each story-arc part point back to it: ____________________.
cards.beginningPrompt: Beginning: write the compass craft goal, the first direction note, and the character who wants to solve it: ____________________.
cards.middleChangePrompt: Middle change: make one compass point change, wobble, or reveal a new craft mark that complicates the goal: ____________________.
cards.choiceBridgePrompt: Choice bridge: let the character choose between two compass notes and explain how the choice keeps the arc aimed at the goal: ____________________.
cards.consequencePrompt: Consequence: write what happens to the craft project because of the chosen compass note: ____________________.
cards.endingReturnPrompt: Ending return: bring back the first compass goal and show whether the final paper note points closer to it: ____________________.
cards.arcFolderPrompt: Arc folder note: sort the compass goal, changed point, choice note, and ending return into the accordion folder: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: write the compass goal, one changed point, and one ending return sentence: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: save the Compass Craft Academy arc in the paper folder and add one new direction note later: ____________________.

cards.title: Greenhouse Gear Garden Story Arc Card
cards.arcSkill: reset the accordion folder with one ending return note
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only accordion folder card for finishing a Greenhouse Gear Garden story arc with a reset note: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: keep the work private and offline, set out paper, pencil, this card, and an accordion folder for gear-garden arc pieces: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: with the adult, move the gear garden story from first problem to changed middle, choice, result, and calm return: ____________________.
cards.beginningPrompt: Beginning: write the first greenhouse gear detail, such as a turning wheel, label tag, or garden crank that starts the arc: ____________________.
cards.middleChangePrompt: Middle change: show one gear-garden part changing position so the character has to rethink the next paper step: ____________________.
cards.choiceBridgePrompt: Choice bridge: let the character choose one gentle repair, reset, or note-check that links the middle to the ending: ____________________.
cards.consequencePrompt: Consequence: write what changes in the greenhouse gear garden after that choice, using only made-up story details: ____________________.
cards.endingReturnPrompt: Ending return: bring back the first gear detail and write the reset note that closes the story arc: ____________________.
cards.arcFolderPrompt: Arc folder note: place the beginning gear detail, middle change, choice, result, and reset note into accordion order: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: write only the first gear detail, the changed part, and the reset note: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: keep the Greenhouse Gear Garden arc in the paper folder and add another ending return note later: ____________________.
